mapper.select: SELECT product_id AS productId, product_name AS productName, quantity, price, total_price AS totalPrice, product_image AS productImage FROM tb_order_item WHERE order_id = #{orderId}

SELECT p.product_id AS productId, p.name AS name, p.product_image AS productImage, p.price AS price, COUNT(*) AS buyCount FROM tb_order_item oi1 JOIN tb_order_item oi2 ON oi1.order_id = oi2.order_id AND oi1.product_id != oi2.product_id JOIN tb_product p ON oi2.product_id = p.product_id JOIN tb_order o ON oi2.order_id = o.order_id WHERE oi1.product_id = #{productId} AND o.order_status = 1 AND o.del_flag = 0 AND oi1.del_flag = 0 AND oi2.del_flag = 0 AND p.del_flag = 0 GROUP BY oi2.product_id, p.name, p.product_image, p.price ORDER BY buyCount DESC LIMIT 10
